messages:
alex: kicking off bring-up of q-nova-7b-int4 (int4 quant). planning a canary across promptset_v3 + golden_v2. noticed embedding drift on early evals and a handful of hallucination spikes.

maria: thanks alex — can you paste the eval diff? curious which prompt families fail.

alex: quick diff snippet from eval harness:
```
- baseline redwood/v6: avg_halluc=0.12, longsum_f1=0.78
- q-nova-7b-int4: avg_halluc=0.18, longsum_f1=0.71
```
12/100 examples drove most of the delta, many are long-context instruction-following.

sam: @alex @maria I saw something similar with qX-series earlier — long summaries get overly terse or invent facts. Suggest running the newmodel-smoke script that compares top-k token overlap and halluc_score vs baseline before we expand the golden.

alex: ran smoke, results: pass on 82/100, but 12/100 had hallucination_score >0.6. Command used: 
```
./tools/newmodel-smoke --model=q-nova-7b-int4 --prompts=promptset_v3/sample_1k.json --baseline=redwood/v6
```
Outputs uploaded to /tmp/qnova_smoke_4156.tar.gz

jin: @labelops we need to triage those 12 failing cases. Can you pull them into a golden review batch? Prefer microgolden size 50 with enriched context (full convo + metadata).

labelops: noted — creating batch in LabelFlow, tag=qnova_03_halluc. ETA tomorrow EOD. Will include original prompt, baseline answer, q-nova answer, and hallucination markers.

maria: also dedupe note: promptset_v3 has ~4% near-duplicates (found via fuzzyhash) that inflate recall metrics. Can we run a fuzzy dedupe pass with radius=0.85 before labeling? That way label effort targets unique failure modes.

sam: +1. Command: 
```
python infra/dedupe.py --input=promptset_v3.json --thresh=0.85 --out=promptset_v3.dedup.json
```
I'll kick this off after lunch.

alex: good. operational decision: we should also add 200 curated examples to golden covering long-summary, instruction-following, and code-safety. Who owns curation?

maria: I can lead curation for long-summary + instruction-following. I'll pull 120 hand-curated examples from the 'longsum-canon' repo and sample 50 from recent customer telemetry (anonymized). @jin can handle code-safety examples.

jin: yep, will pick 80 code-safety examples from repo 'safety-stubs' and craft 20 synthetic edgecases (obfuscated PII + prompt-injection patterns). Will tag them qnova_code_safety.

labelops: once deduped and curated, we'll run microgoldens and produce precision/recall + regression_rate vs baseline. Recommended pass threshold for this bring-up: precision >= 0.90 and recall >= 0.85 relative to baseline on golden_v2 slices.

alex: agreed. If microgolden fails on any critical slice (long-summary / code-safety), fallback routing to q-nova-7b-int8 for those routes until we mitigate. We'll add route-level policy in routing-config under models.experimental.qnova.

sam: I'll add a canary dashboard tile in Console: model=q-nova-7b-int4, routes=[/gen/longsum,/gen/code,/gen/instruct], metrics=[latency,p99,regression_rate,halluc_score]. Also will surface tokenizer mismatch alerts.

maria: one more ask — snapshot tokenizer/version and quant kernel metadata. Int4 quant sometimes pairs with subtle tokenization drift that affects long summaries.

alex: snapshot done: tokenizer=v2.3.1, vocab-hash=sha256:abc123def456, quant-kernel=nv-fused-int4-v1. Artifacts saved to s3://redwood-ops/qnova/4156789012/meta.json

curation-bot: created issue #412 in repo 'model-onboard' titled 'qnova onboarding — golden expansion & dedupe' and assigned to @maria, @jin, @labelops. Link: https://github.com/redwood/model-onboard/issues/412

alex: plan summary: dedupe today, curation tomorrow, labeling + microgolden Thu-Fri, decision window Mon morning. If pass, canary traffic ramp starting Mon evening. If fail, route-level fallback and postmortem sprint. :rocket:

maria: will post progress updates to this thread and ping when curated set is uploaded to s3. :+1:
